item.title: Prosecutor with Soros ties criticized after accused killer obtained passport and left US
item.description: A Democratic prosecutor in Fairfax County, Virginia, did not oppose an embassy visit that allowed an accused killer to get a passport and flee the country.

item.title: Axelrod Criticizes Ossoff Over 'Gratuitous' Remark About Natalie Harp
item.description: Democratic strategist David Axelrod on Wednesday criticized comments by Sen. Jon Ossoff, D-Ga., about President Donald Trump and his longtime aide.

Karen Bass Criticized After Video Shows Taxpayer-Funded Match for Campaign Donations
item.description: Democratic Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass faces scrutiny over a re-election ad that urges donations matched 6-to-1 by taxpayers through the super match program.
